name: Main Lobby Touch Panel
description: Wall-mounted 10.1 inch touch panel for reception. Used to check in visitors, page security, and display building announcements.

name: Boardroom Display North
description: 85 inch 4K display at the north end of the executive boardroom. Drives the primary content from the in-room PC and from BYOD wireless sharing.
notes: Calibrated for warm color profile per facilities standard.

name: Boardroom DSP
description: Audio digital signal processor handling 8 ceiling microphones, beamforming for the conference table, and AEC for the far-end call experience.
notes: Beamform zones tuned 2026-02-05. AEC reference set to display HDMI.

name: Cafe Scheduling Panel A
description: Outside-room scheduling panel for the Cafe collaboration space. Shows current and next meeting and supports ad-hoc booking.

name: Cafe Camera A
description: All-in-one video bar mounted under the Cafe-A display. Provides smart framing and speaker tracking during Teams Rooms calls.
notes: Reports intermittent USB renegotiation. Ticket INC-44218 open with vendor.

name: Loading Dock Motion Sensor
description: Dual technology occupancy sensor over the inbound loading dock door. Drives lighting scenes and alerts security after hours.
notes: Time-of-day rules sourced from facilities calendar.

name: Studio Camera 1
description: Cinema line PTZ camera mounted on the upstage truss of recording studio A. Controlled from the gallery for hybrid all-hands productions.
notes: Lens preset bank refreshed each Monday.

name: Studio Confidence Monitor
description: 55 inch confidence monitor on the talent floor that shows the live program feed and a return cue feed during all-hands.

name: Studio Audio Console
description: Digital audio console handling 32 mic preamps, the broadcast mix bus, and the cue feed for talent in-ears.
notes: Show files versioned in the broadcast share each Friday.

name: Training Room Touch Panel
description: Tabletop touch panel that runs the room mode UI for the training room. Switches between local PC, instructor laptop, and wireless sharing.

name: Training Room Projector
description: 20000 lumen laser projector with edge-blend onto a 24 foot screen. Used for instructor-led classes and town halls overflow.

name: Annex Floor 2 Scheduling Panel
description: Outside-room scheduling panel for Annex floor 2 meeting room 3. Currently offline pending PoE switch replacement.
notes: Network port disabled until cabling crew returns 2026-05-19.

name: Annex Lobby Digital Sign
description: 85 inch portrait digital signage display in the Annex lobby. Cycles between visitor wayfinding, daily menu, and security announcements.
notes: Content feed from the CMS playlist Annex-Lobby-Daily.

name: Server Room Environmental Sensor
description: Environmental sensor tracking temperature, humidity, and door contact for the HQ server room. Alerts trigger when temperature exceeds 27 C.
notes: Thresholds aligned with facilities standard FAC-ENV-04.

name: Executive Suite Touch Panel
description: 7 inch wall panel for the executive suite. Drives lighting scenes, shade control, and an HDMI input selector for the side display.
